review.imagery: 42 gallery entries include 9 dated construction photographs. All 21 official primary assets, the entire 37-page brochure index, fifteen native resources and all nine September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. Twelve additional original brochure scenes add lagoon panoramas, pool and balcony views, shared seating, gym, kitchen and bathroom interiors. Two lifestyle portraits and a water texture are excluded. Proposed lagoon and skyline renders retain design scope. The complete tower and podium supply card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All 22 complete physical drawing pages 2–23 were visually reviewed on six contacts. Podiums have residential portions alongside parking. The penthouse roof stays separately labelled as an upper portion. Three public broker 1 BR images were independently viewed at native size. Their remaining layouts require a form and were left unretrieved. No room dimensions or category ranges were multiplied into individual areas. Twenty-two complete building sheets cover ground, four podiums, floor 1 with amenities, residential levels through floor 18 and a separate penthouse roof portion. Three separately attributed broker images add 1 BR previews. These sheets state no numerical individual saleable areas. The roof portion does not establish a separate whole-home total. Confirm the exact selected unit, area and final revision with Imtiaz.
review.location: Brochure pages 12–14 were rendered at 3200 pixels. Regional map 12 and complete district schematic 14 were visually reviewed. The original future metro label remains proposed. No time was assigned from drawn proximity. The official named-place embed supplies camera-centre values without explicit target coordinates, so named-project directions are retained.
review.provenance: Current official HTML/gallery and September 2026 history pages retain dated URL and byte/hash receipts. Branded brochure and building-plan mirrors retain honest Mitchell’s or Reelly attribution. Open broker plan-image URLs were observed in public figures. Source bytes, complete drawing sheets and notices are preserved. Original completed text research and protected identities remain intact.

unavailable: Individual contractual areas and numbered-unit matching for previews, detailed developer home sheets, form-gated additional broker layouts, exact entrance, numerical original-source route times, operating status of the proposed metro, current certified construction completion and guaranteed final views remain unavailable or unverified.
